summary: Initializes a float min/max range pair and precomputes the inverse range used for linear proportion lookups. Stores argument a2 as the range minimum (field 0x0) and a3 as the range maximum (field 0x4), then stores 1/(a3 - a2) in field 0x8 when the range is positive, otherwise 0.0, guarding against division by zero for empty or inverted ranges. On the frame path per the packet.

operations.description: Compute the range width v3 = a3 - a2 as a double before any field writes.
Store the range minimum: *this = a2, i.e. field 0x0 receives argument a2.
Store the range maximum: this[1] = a3, i.e. field 0x4 receives argument a3.
Guard on the computed range width: if v3 (a3 - a2) is <= 0.0 the range is empty or inverted.
When the range is not positive, field 0x8 is set to 0.0 (no valid proportion scale).
Otherwise field 0x8 is set to 1.0 / v3, the precomputed inverse range (1/(max-min)).
